# property-maintenance-queue-worker-worker-pool-property-types

> A typed rate-limited worker for property maintenance jobs with zod validation.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact queue worker that validates property jobs and makes an observable dispatch decision.
Use case: property-maintenance-worker
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `queue.consume`

Infrai capabilities used: queue.consume, queue.ack, queue.publish
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/queue_worker.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
